Connor White, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report and Kelly Schroeder,
AVIP.C., provided additional information.

27. RESOLUTION ~ To initiate annexation proceedings by the City of Cheyenne for an area
generally located west of Interstate 25, north of State Highway 210, east of Roundtop
Road, and south of Horsecreek Road, commonly known as Francis E. Warren Air Force
Base, Wyoming. (SPONSORS ~ DR. ALDRICH AND MR. SEGRAVE)

Dr. Aldrich moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Laybourn. Dr. Aldrich moved to amend by
substitute dated July 3, 2023, seconded by Mr. Laybourn. Motion to amend failed with Dr. Aldrich
voting “YES” and Mr. Laybourn voting “NO”. Main motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

John Brodie, Deputy City Attomey, provided a staff report and Councilman Tom Segrave, and
sponsor of the item, provided additional information. Committee member Laybourn commented
on the item.

There being no further items for the agenda to come before the Public Services Committee, the
meeting was adjourned at 2:05 p.m.
